atomic_questions.shared_background: Anura Perera your client wants to purchase a house and property situated in Rajagiriya said to be belonging to one Kusum Peiris and gives you a copy of a Transfer Deed No. 234 dated 23rd March, 2015 attested by Walter de Silva Notary Public and a copy of a Survey Plan No.1125 dated 2nd January, 2000 made by Anil Silva Licensed Surveyor relating to an allotment of land marked Lot B together with a Reservation for a Road marked Lot R of the Land called Dewatagahawatta in extent of 30 perches situated in Rajagiriya. On examining the documents tendered and after a search at the Colombo Land Registry you observe that Lot B and R depicted in the said Survey Plan are sub-divisions of Lot 1 containing in extent of One Rood and 10 Perches depicted in Partition Plan No. 567 dated 4th April 1998 also made by Anil Silva Licensed Surveyor (herein after referred to as the Original land). 1. The Original Land was allotted to one Alfred Almeida by Final Decree in the District Court of Colombo Partition case No. 1256/P and subsequently by Survey Plan 1125 made by Anil Silva Licensed surveyor sub-divided the said Lot 1 into 4 allotments of land marked A,B,C.and R. and by Deed of Transfer No. 234 dated 23rd March 2015 attested by Walter de Silva Notary Public sold Lot B together with undivided 1/3rd share of the Road Reservation marked Lot R to Sunil Peiris. 2. Sunil Peiris had died Intestate without children on 6th December 2016 leaving behind his widow Kusum Peiris. His estate was duly Administered in District Court Testamentary Case No. 345/16/T and proceedings terminated on 7th May 2018.On examining the Testamentary Case it was observed that the father of Sunil Peiris one Charles Peiris had pre-deceased him leaving behind 2 children named Upul and Wimal by his 1st marriage to Kamala Peiris and three children named Sunil, Kanthi and Manel by his 2nd marriage to Pushpa Peiris. Pushpa Peiris was alive and she too had a child by her 1st marriage to Lal Perera named Keerthi Perera and three children named Sunil, Kanthi and Manel by her 2nd marriage to Charles Peiris.
